author: dmatveev
title: GPU unit tests fail to extract OpenVINO package - tbb12.dll locked on Windows self-hosted runner
signature: remove item cannot remove item access to the path is denied unauthorizedaccessexception|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step fails: Remove-Item cannot delete tbb12.dll, Access to the path is denied.

key_errors: 2026-11-16T10:46:37.6274939Z Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied.
root_cause: The self-hosted Windows GPU runner re-extracts the openvino_package.zip/openvino_tests.zip archives into the shared install directory, and PowerShell's Expand-Archive tries to delete a pre-existing tbb12.dll before overwriting it. The DLL is held open (locked) by a lingering process from a previous job/run on the same persistent runner (antivirus scanning or a still-running OpenVINO process holding a handle to the DLL), so Remove-Item throws UnauthorizedAccessException and the extraction step fails with exit code 1. This is the same recurring Windows self-hosted runner workspace-locking issue seen 10 prior times in the pattern database (count now 11), not a code defect introduced by this PR.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible outside the actual Windows self-hosted GPU runner workspace: requires the shared persistent runner filesystem state (a locked tbb12.dll from a prior run) to trigger. Locally, this can be approximated by holding an open file handle to a DLL and then running Expand-Archive -Force to overwrite it, which raises the same UnauthorizedAccessException.
recommended_actions: Ensure the Windows GPU runner workspace is fully cleaned/reset between jobs (e.g., kill lingering OpenVINO/test processes and release file handles before the next checkout/extract step).
Add a pre-extract cleanup step that retries Remove-Item/Expand-Archive with backoff, or use robocopy/7z extraction that tolerates locked files better than Expand-Archive.
Consider excluding or hard-killing any process holding tbb12.dll (e.g., via Get-Process/handle.exe) before extraction.
If runners are ephemeral-capable, prefer fresh runner instances per job to avoid locked-file carryover.
prevention_strategies: Add workspace hygiene steps (process cleanup, retry-with-backoff for Expand-Archive, or handle-unlocking) to the GPU unit tests job on Windows self-hosted runners; consider migrating to ephemeral runners for this job to eliminate cross-run file-lock contamination.
historical_context: This exact signature has recurred 11 times (first seen 2026-11-09T19:06:46Z), always on the GPU unit tests Windows job during the 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step with the same tbb12.dll UnauthorizedAccessException. A rerun-pattern proposal for this signature (PR #39664) was previously opened and subsequently closed/rejected, so no new rerun-pattern proposal is submitted this time.
